document: H5A-A1 preregistration for the M2 soft-budget / investment-hunger enterprise-chain experiment. It is an explicitly synthetic structural experiment on the read-only Intermediate-8 branch; it does not restore the Hungarian F2 replay and it cannot promote any historical status.

legacy_card.hypothesis: soft budget plus investment hunger is sufficient to sustain systemic shortage independently of the demand regime.
legacy_card.falsification_criterion: with hardness raised and credit cut, the shortage metrics do not fall.

run.seed_role: household-heterogeneity robustness over the stochastic initial draw; NOT independent historical samples and NOT enterprise-decision noise. Seed count is never used to manufacture significance.

base.description: All original HouseholdParameters from the read-only intermediate8 scenario.

reduced.description: For every household-good channel h: base_per_equivalent_person[h] = max(original_minimum_per_equivalent_person[h], 0.5 * original_base_per_equivalent_person[h]). minimum_per_equivalent_person is unchanged for every channel. All other demand parameters are unchanged.

policy.budget_design_note: soft/hard is a JOINT intervention on two policy coordinates. budget_hardness maps onto bailout_envelope_fraction = base * (1 - hardness) and credit_fraction maps onto credit_envelope_fraction. The budget effect may never be called a pure hardness effect; the credit_cut and rescue_cut arms exist to decompose the joint contrast.
policy.investment_mapping_note: investment_intensity scales material_parameters.hunger_base by the declared factor: 1.0 -> original hunger_base, 2.0 -> doubled. hunger_bailout and hunger_shortage are unchanged.

fixed.policy_construction: default_initial_policy(scenario).patch(...) then PolicyVector validation; model_copy is never used to set a policy coordinate

policy.bounds_note: POLICY_BOUNDS investment_intensity = (0.0, 2.0). Any spec value outside the declared bounds is rejected before the model is initialised.

placebo_note: placebo_soft_low_base is bit-identical in treatment to soft_low_base and differs only in its arm label. Its comparison, final-state and journal digests MUST equal the base arm's; any difference is a defect, not a finding.

mapped_counters.study_note: Exported per quarter, but a single count column may never by itself support a mechanism conclusion.

blocked_metrics.study_note: Replaced by commodity+stage+purpose scoped gross and funded gap ratios that export numerator, denominator and unit explicitly. A zero denominator returns value=null with status=ZERO_DENOMINATOR; a missing axis returns BLOCKED_METRIC. Neither is zero-filled.

blocked_metrics.h0b_block_reason: separator undeclared; the composite is not a defined quantity
blocked_metrics.study_note: credit_drawn and shortage_expectation_mean are exported as two separate per-organization and aggregate sequences. No slash composite is computed and no meaning is guessed for it.

blocked_metrics.h0b_block_reason: no producer; the named axis does not exist
blocked_metrics.study_note: Closing stock is reported as a sum over the actual (commodity, stage) stock cells read from the state, with its source named. No commodity_circuit quantity is fabricated.

new_metrics.definition: sum(ordered_gross - delivered) / sum(ordered_gross), grouped by commodity+stage+purpose.
sum(ordered - delivered) / sum(ordered), grouped by commodity+stage+purpose.
Organization capacity times investment hunger recomputed independently from the opening state and the effective parameters; never read from the capped flows field.
organization_investment_completed: capacity units installed this quarter, not ordered capacity and not newly added stock.
Household desired quantity summed with real household weight, reported per household-good channel and per commodity. Heterogeneous physical units are never pooled into a single welfare total.

falsification_rule.statement: with hardness raised and credit cut, the shortage metrics do not fall.
falsification_rule.tested_as: budget contrast Y(soft,H) - Y(hard,H) on the pre-registered axis-scoped gap ratios, per demand regime and per seed, plus the credit_cut and rescue_cut decomposition.
falsification_rule.conditions_for_reading: A budget contrast is only readable when the budget first stage is binding: credit drawn must actually differ between the compared arms, and the rescue leg must either bind or be reported NONBINDING.
falsification_rule.not_claimed: Four quarters of a synthetic branch cannot establish the card's sufficiency claim, and no result here can raise the historical identification status.

first_stage_adjudication.budget: Does the budget regime actually move credit_drawn and bailout_granted?
first_stage_adjudication.investment: Does investment_intensity move unconstrained request, approval, investment-purpose procurement and installed capacity?
first_stage_adjudication.demand_regime: Does the reduced regime move the real weighted household desired quantity?

completion_rule: status is COMPLETED only for the full 3 seeds x 13 arms design; any seed or arm subset is PARTIAL; any conservation failure, baseline collapse or invariant breach stops the run and records the failing seed/arm/tick.
no_posterior_search: No additional mechanism cards, source scenarios or post-hoc parameter search are permitted in this study.
